name: Center-Based Head Start & Early Head Start
description: Free and low-cost center-based programs for children birth to five in Franklin, Hampshire and Western Hampden Counties. Part-day preschool is offered in Franklin and Hampshire counties, and full-day, full-year programs for children birth to five are offered in Amherst, Northampton and Turners Falls. All meals and snacks are free to families.
contact: Enrollment: 413-387-1250, hselpenrollment@communityaction.us; Amherst Community Child Care: 413-548-1290

requirements.text: For children birth to five. Part-day services are for preschoolers; full-day services are for infants, toddlers and preschoolers.

Part-day/extended-day: your family may qualify if it has a low income; if anyone in your family receives SSI, DTA Cash, or SNAP benefits; if your child is a foster child; or if your family is staying with friends or family temporarily, living in a shelter or motel, or otherwise without housing.

Full-day: your family may qualify if it already has a child care voucher, has an open case with the Department of Children and Families, or has income under 50% of the State Median Income and needs child care for work, school or job search.
